title: Maria Has a Cold
text:
Maria has a cold. She feels tired and her head hurts. She stays at home and drinks hot tea. She goes to bed early.

The next day, Maria feels better. She still has a little cough, but she can go to school. Her mother says, "Drink water and rest." Maria thinks she is lucky.

questions.text: What does Maria's mother say to do?
Why does Maria stay at home on the first day?
Is Maria completely well at the end of the passage?
options: No, she still has a cough
Yes, she went to the doctor

vocabulary.definition: a common illness that makes your nose run and your throat hurt
a sudden, loud noise you make in your throat when you are ill
to stop working or moving so your body can recover

paragraph_translations: Maria está resfriada. Ela se sente cansada e a cabeça dói. Ela fica em casa e bebe chá quente. Ela vai para a cama cedo.
No dia seguinte, Maria se sente melhor. Ela ainda tem uma pequena tosse, mas pode ir à escola. A mãe dela diz: "Beba água e descanse." Maria acha que tem sorte.
